facts.fact: FaydaVerse says its identity authentication service, using one-time passwords, has processed about 200 million authentication operations and about two million verification requests a day, charged to banks and other institutions since August 2026.
FaydaVerse says its verification service is open to government institutions, private companies and start-ups, with banks named as users.

facts.fact: FaydaVerse says the national ID had registered 52.4 million people by 15 October 2026 and printed over 14.5 million credentials.
FaydaVerse says banks and other organisations verify customers through its ID verification service, which it has charged for since August 2026.
FaydaVerse says the system has processed about 200 million authentications and handles about two million verification requests a day.
